# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 3: Condottieri Contracts, Free Company Mutiny Disaster & Gunpowder Logistics Reform (oe_mer2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_mercenaries.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. True if the country holds any active 5-year regional mercenary charter.
oe_mer2_has_any_charter = {
	OR = {
		has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_condottieri
		has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_swiss
		has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_landsknechte
		has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_stradioti
		has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_charter_kriegsunternehmer
	}
}

# Country scope. True if the country currently employs mercenaries or holds a mercenary charter.
oe_mer2_has_hired_or_chartered_mercs = {
	OR = {
		any_hired_mercenary = { count > 0 }
		oe_mer2_has_any_charter = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Guarded arrears-risk threshold helpers (strictly zero unguarded var reads).
oe_mer2_risk_at_least_15 = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk }
		var:oe_mer2_arrears_risk >= 15
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

oe_mer2_risk_at_least_40 = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk }
		var:oe_mer2_arrears_risk >= 40
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

oe_mer2_risk_at_most_10 = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk }
		var:oe_mer2_arrears_risk <= 10
	}
	trigger_else = { always = yes }
}

oe_mer2_risk_at_most_20 = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk }
		var:oe_mer2_arrears_risk <= 20
	}
	trigger_else = { always = yes }
}

# Country scope. Ruler, regent, or any cabinet councillor has at least 50 Military skill.
oe_mer2_has_mil_50_leadership = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_ruler = yes
			ruler ?= { mil >= 50 }
		}
		AND = {
			has_regent = yes
			regent ?= { mil >= 50 }
		}
		any_cabinet_character = {
			mil >= 50
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) rebel-guarded host filter for yearly arrears risk tracking.
oe_mer2_is_mercenary_risk_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mer2_standing_army_reformed }
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_mer2_arrears_risk
		any_hired_mercenary = { count >= 2 }
		oe_mer2_has_any_charter = yes
	}
}
